description_en: Uploads samples for the risk identification service
description_zh: 用于风险识别服务的样本上传
kebab_example: aliyun safconsole upload-sample-api --sample-type block --data-type ip --service account_abuse,coupon_abuse,account_takeover --data-value 123.124.125.126_,_123.124.125.127 --api-version 2021-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadSampleApi

parameters.help_en:
The type of the sample. Valid values:

block: blacklist
pass: whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
样本的类型

黑名单: block

白名单: pass
parameters.name: sample_type

parameters.help_en:
The data type of the sample. Valid values:

mobile: phone number
mobileMd5: MD5 hash of a phone number
IP: IP address
umid: unique device ID
accountId: account ID
imei: IMEI
imeiMd5: MD5 hash of an IMEI
oaid: OAID
oaidMd5: MD5 hash of an OAID
androidId: Android ID
androidIdMd5: MD5 hash of an Android ID
parameters.help_zh:
样本的数据类型

手机号: mobile
手机号MD5: mobileMd5
IP: ip
设备唯一id: umid
账号: accountId
imei: imei
imeiMd5: imeiMd5
oaid: oaid
oaidMd5: oaidMd5
androidId: androidId
androidIdMd5: androidIdMd5
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of services for which the samples take effect. Separate multiple services with commas. Valid values:

account_abuse: Registration Risk Identification Basic Edition or Enhanced Edition
coupon_abuse: Marketing Risk Identification Basic Edition or Enhanced Edition
account_takeover: Logon Risk Identification Basic Edition or Enhanced Edition
parameters.help_zh:
生效服务的列表,多个服务用逗号分开

注册风险识别基础版/增强版: account_abuse
营销风险识别基础版/增强版: coupon_abuse
登录风险识别基础版/增强版: account_takeover
parameters.name: service

parameters.help_en: The specific values of the samples, passed in JSON format. Do not exceed 1000 entries at a time
parameters.help_zh: 样本的具体值，以JSON格式传入。一次不要超过1000条
parameters.name: data_value

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the access was successful
